name: Joined Wings
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Joined Wings (Teamwork)
Source Distant Realms pg. 33
You have developed a deep rapport with your comrades that allows you to swiftly convey divine grace.

Prerequisites: Fervor or lay on hands class feature.

Benefit: You can use your lay on hands or the healing granted by fervor on allies with this feat as a swift action.
